verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs state it offers two types of status pages, public and private, and that status pages can serve both internal stakeholders and external customers. That confirms a first-party private/internal status page capability. However, the pack never describes how access is controlled (SSO, password, IP allowlist, per-user permissions) or whether pages can be scoped to specific customers. Missing for 10: documented access-control mechanism for private pages, customer-specific audience segmentation, employee-only authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
